mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT DATE(create_time) FROM sa_learning_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY DATE(create_time) DESC

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, SUM(duration_minutes) AS value FROM sa_learning_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT DATE(submitted_at) AS date, AVG(score) AS value FROM sa_quiz WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND submitted_at >= #{begin} AND submitted_at < #{end} GROUP BY DATE(submitted_at) ORDER BY date ASC
